body.message:
Good afternoon Mr Zaid,

I hope you are doing well.

Please accept our sincere apologies for the delay in providing an update regarding the parking fine.

We have checked with the City Walk management team, and as per the information received, the fine was issued because the vehicle was parked in a parking slot other than the designated parking space provided for your unit.

Since the vehicle was parked in a different parking slot, the management team has confirmed that they are unable to waive the fine.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this matter may have caused and appreciate your kind understanding and cooperation.
